# Welcome to the Colossus Sector.
You wake up... Somewhere. Maybe you're a marine from the local Federation flagship, maybe you're a vanguard who obeys only the Sultan, maybe you're just some lonely schmuck who's down on their luck throwing the dice in one last gambit. Regardless how you've gotten here, things are very different from "conventional" Space Station 14 lore.
- [bold]Nanotrasen is destroyed. - [bold]The Syndicate is shattered. - [bold]It has been decades since the Corporate War that started this all.[/bold]
Throw away preconceptions of being yet another generic corporate wage-slave in a retro-modern cold war. In the Colossus sector, you only truly owe loyalty to yourself. Watch your back.
The following sections contain important context to the story of the world you find yourself in. [color=red][bold]It is highly recommended you at least read the content in this primer.[/bold][/red]
# The Colossus Radius
You, and everyone else here, are within the influence of a mythical anomalous region commonly referred to as [color=pink]"The Colossus Radius"[/color]. This region encompasses what is known in common starmaps as [color=orange]the Colossus sector[/color], on the fringe of civilized space in the Perseus arm. [color=pink]"The Colossus Radius"[/color] causes many strange phenomena, including (but not limited to) sentient fleshbeasts, highly advanced automated killing machines, mysterious forms of matter, and Blue Lobsters, almost all of which will cause a quick demise to the unprepared explorer. It also creates significant interference at the fringes of space - Those who enter the Colossus sector often are unable to leave.
Not much is known about the Colossus radius, but since its discovery it has caused significant scientific intrigue attracting many different people in an incursion like a smaller Confederate Expansion.
# Factions
It has been a long time since the Corporate War that ripped the galaxy in two. The ashes of this conflict include:
- The [color=cyan]Trans-Solarian Federation (TSF)[/color], a security agency resulting from the fallout of the Confederacy and seeking to prevent another great expansion at all costs. They use advanced technology from the scraps recovered from the Confederacy military, but are stretched for resources in the sector due to separation from supportive infrastructure.
- The [color=orange]Phaethon Dynasty Vanguard (PDV)[/color], an old imperial house native to the Colossus sector that got boosted into galactic relevance with the discovery of ancient corporate technology decades ago. They seek to spread the rule of the Sultan, but struggle for technological advancement due to radical thought being dangerous in the Dynasty.
While the TSF and the PDV are not officially in active conflict, they are very much at odds with one another - The TSF believe the PDV are on the verge of starting a radical galactic holy war even bigger than the Great Confederate Expansion, and seek to stop it at all costs, while the PDV believe the technology used by the TSF is a defamation of the Sultan's powers. Due to the anomalous interference at the fringes of the Colossus sector, the local Federation military is seperated from their main battalions, and the Dynasty is still a developing power. This has lead to a localized stalemate.
